description: Crazy World Progression is a Fabric-based server-wide progression framework for Minecraft. It provides configurable global skills, technologies, upgrades, and gameplay modifiers that allow player decisions and server events to shape the evolution of the world.

mods.name: Crazy World Progression
mods.description: A modular RPG and MMO framework for servers and content mods: skill trees and skill levels, item quality and crafting, portals with instanced dungeons and raids, parties, clans, custom mobs with scripted encounters, currencies, storage and more. Every part can be switched off in config/crazy-world-progression.yml.
